channel.title: The Year — The Earthly Book of Hours
channel.description: The year a day at a time, as kept in the Boston Basin: a subject of the season each day, with an image and a reading, and each week its Lectio Terra essay. It comes round again every year.

item.title: Lectio Terra: Wintergreen
item.description:
Jacob Bigelow, Henry David Thoreau, Linda M. Sweeting

Instead of receiving its first frost this week, the Boston area experienced a final illusion of summer, with clear blue skies and gentle warm breezes. Then the rain set in for a few days. The long-lasting summer has, paradoxically, spurred some early reflections on winter. Though we haven’t actually experienced any true cold yet, I’m preparing my psyche for the insular dimensions of the impending…

item.title: Lectio Terra: First Frost
item.description:
William Cullen Bryant, Hannah Arendt, Homer C. Sampson, Thomas Hardy

We interrupt this fall’s journey through the northeast woodlands with a reflection on the threshold that is the first frost (prima pruina, if it were a Latin binomial).
